ego-browser.chromeArgsHint: Appended to the Chrome launch argv. Takes effect on the next browser cold start (the browser is a singleton — run `ego-browser --stop` or restart DSH to relaunch). Blocked: --user-data-dir/--remote-debugging-port/--remote-allow-origins/--headless/--no-startup-window/--proxy-server (use EGO_LINUX_PROXY for the proxy).
ego-browser.chromePathHint: Path to the Chrome/Chromium/Edge binary. Empty = auto-detect.
ego-browser.disableFrameRelayHint: No picture is relayed at all: no ego-cast worker, no CDP/WGC screencast capture, no ffmpeg pull, and the watch panel opens no stream. ego_* tools keep working normally.
ego-browser.disableFrameRelayOn: On (no picture pushed to this page)
ego-browser.egoCliArgsHint: Appended to `ego-browser nodejs` argv. Takes effect on the next ego_* call. Blocked: --status/--stop/--open/--spaces/--help (they exit before the heredoc runs). Use --headless via the headless env instead.
ego-browser.ffmpegUnsupported: FFmpeg capture is unsupported on this platform
ego-browser.githubMirrorHint: Replaces https://github.com for GitHub downloads, for example https://gh-proxy.com/github.com.
ego-browser.idleTimeoutMinHint: Stop the backing browser after N minutes without an ego_* call (0 = off). It cold-starts on the next call (~2-4s). Watching the panel does not count as activity.
ego-browser.intro: Agent browser integration. Configure the Chrome/Chromium binary path and cast parameters below.
ego-browser.isolateSpacesHint: Disabled: use persistent disk profile, logins stay across restarts. Enabled: memory-only sandbox per task.
ego-browser.loginImportBusy: Working… (a running source browser may need to close first)
ego-browser.loginImportCloseSource: Close the source browser first if it is running (windows restore on next launch)
ego-browser.loginImportClosed: (source browser was closed and can be reopened)
ego-browser.loginImportDomainsHint: e.g. bilibili.com, zhihu.com — subdomains included. Prefer an explicit list over importing everything.
ego-browser.loginImportIntro: Copy login cookies from your daily Chrome/Edge/Brave into the agent browser (CDP passthrough — no offline decryption). Probe first, then import with an explicit domain list.
ego-browser.loginImportProbeResult: Importable: {matched} cookies across {domains} domains (read {total} total) — nothing was written.
ego-browser.loginImportResult: Imported {written} cookies across {domains} domains from {source}. They persist across restarts.
ego-browser.namespaceUnavailable: The ego-browser configuration channel is unavailable. Please retry later.
ego-browser.readOnly: Settings are read-only in this deployment.
ego-browser.relayDisabledBody: Turn off "Disable live frame relay" in Settings → Plugins → ego-browser to see the live view here.
ego-browser.title: ego-browser
